settings.heading: EDUCATION THROUGH EVERY KNOT: INVESTING IN CHILDREN’S LEARNING

settings.text:
At Indian Rug Store, our every knot woven into exquisite rugs contributes to the child education programs. The beauty of our rugs is not just a reflection to craftmanship, but also a sign of the ties that bind us to our communities for betterment. That's why we are focused to empower the next generation through education.

Our Mission: Education Through Every Knot

As we all know education is the only key to have a brighter future, and every child deserves the opportunity to learn, grow, and thrive. Through our CSR initiative, "Education Through Every Knot" we have been generating a lasting impact on children's education. For every rug weaved and sold, a proportion of it goes to the funds of educational programs for children in underprivileged communities.

  • Support for Schools in Need: We have been working with local and international organizations to provide stationery, technology, and teaching materials for schools to improve the learning experience for children.
  • Scholarships for Underprivileged Children: We as an organization believes that no child should leave his dream to educate due to financial constraints. We provide scholarships to support talented students who have the ability to succeed but lacks quality education due to financial conditions.

settings.title: BUILDING FUTURES, ONE KNOT AT A TIME
settings.text: Every product we make contributes to the funding of educational initiatives that have an effect on children's lives. We are investing in the future leaders, inventors, and change agents by promoting educational access.

settings.title: LEARNING fOR A BRIGHTER TOMORROW
settings.text: We are aware that bringing about long-lasting change requires education. Our programs are designed to provide kids the information and abilities they need to create better futures for themselves and their communities.

settings.title: EMPOWERING YOUNG MINDS
settings.text: We make sure that kids have the resources they require to thrive by providing scholarships, constructing schools, and assisting with educational projects. Our investments contribute to ending the poverty cycle and providing future generations with countless chances.
